inherited_policy: Use every known exact polynomial or parameterized SAT lane before designing a new JANUS mechanism. A lane counts as universal polynomial coverage only when admission/discovery, solve, reconstruction and verification all fit one polynomial bound in original input size.

new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.name: NESTED_CNF
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.recognition: F is nested iff augmented incidence graph inc+u(F) is planar; planarity is polynomial/linear-time.
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.solve: Knuth nested-SAT polynomial algorithm; #SAT also polynomial via bounded incidence-treewidth methods.
references: Kratochvil-Krivanek planarity characterization, used explicitly by Gaspers-Szeider, Strong Backdoors to Nested Satisfiability, SAT 2012.

new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.name: ACYCLIC_INCIDENCE_FOREST
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.recognition: Incidence graph is a forest; graph acyclicity is linear-time.
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.solve: SAT and #SAT polynomial on acyclic-incidence formulas.
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.reference: Gaspers-Szeider, Backdoors to Acyclic SAT, ICALP 2012.

new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.name: ACYCLIC_BACKDOOR_TO_TRACTABLE_ARCHIPELAGO
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.statement: For any finite set U of permissively tractable classes, SAT is polynomial on formulas with backdoor treewidth btw_U(F)=1. The algorithm need not explicitly find the acyclic backdoor.
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.example: U={q-Horn,Hitting}; arbitrary-size blocks may land in different classes under assignments while backdoor variables interact in a forest-like torso.
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.why_not_yet_counted_as_unconditional_por: The published theorem guarantees polynomial correctness on the promise class. JANUS still needs a fail-closed admission/certificate interface before using a negative/UNSAT answer on arbitrary input.
new_direct_or_near_direct_lanes.reference: Ganian-Ramanujan-Szeider, Backdoor Treewidth for SAT, SAT 2017.

new_parameter_lanes.name: STRONG_BACKDOOR_TO_NESTED
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: size k of smallest strong Nested-backdoor
new_parameter_lanes.result: SAT and #SAT FPT; FPT-approximation finds a backdoor bounded by a function of optimum.
new_parameter_lanes.safe_polynomial_promotion: fixed constant k; no O(log n) promotion recorded without explicit frozen f(k).
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Gaspers-Szeider, Strong Backdoors to Nested Satisfiability, SAT 2012.

new_parameter_lanes.name: WEAK_FOREST_BACKDOOR_FIXED_D_CNF
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: weak backdoor size k to acyclic-incidence formulas
new_parameter_lanes.result: detection FPT for every fixed d>=3; solve by enumerating assignments and polynomial forest-SAT.
new_parameter_lanes.R50G25X_relevance: All fifteen frozen residuals have maximum clause width <=5, so this lane applies to the entire finite corpus.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Gaspers-Szeider, Backdoors to Acyclic SAT, ICALP 2012.

new_parameter_lanes.name: STRONG_FOREST_BACKDOOR
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: smallest strong backdoor size k to acyclic-incidence formulas
new_parameter_lanes.result: FPT-approximation: either excludes size<=k or returns a strong Forest backdoor of size bounded by the public theorem; SAT/#SAT FPT.
new_parameter_lanes.safe_polynomial_promotion: fixed constant k only unless explicit combined dependence is frozen.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Gaspers-Szeider, Backdoors to Acyclic SAT, ICALP 2012.

new_parameter_lanes.name: BACKDOOR_TO_SMALL_INCIDENCE_TREEWIDTH_FOR_D_CNF
new_parameter_lanes.parameters: fixed maximum clause width d, fixed target incidence-treewidth t, backdoor size k
new_parameter_lanes.runtime: 2^O(k)*|F| with hidden dependence on fixed d,t; algorithm solves SAT or correctly concludes no weak/strong backdoor size<=k to width t.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Fomin-Lokshtanov-Misra-Ramanujan-Saurabh, Solving d-SAT via Backdoors to Small Treewidth, SODA 2015.

new_parameter_lanes.name: BACKDOOR_TREEWIDTH_HORN_DHORN_KROM
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: treewidth of the torso of a strong backdoor, not number of backdoor variables
new_parameter_lanes.result: SAT FPT for Horn, Anti-Horn/dual-Horn and 2CNF; a suitable backdoor of width<=k can be found or excluded by the public FPT algorithm.
new_parameter_lanes.key_relation: backdoor-treewidth <= min(primal-treewidth, ordinary backdoor size), and can stay small when ordinary backdoor size is unbounded.
new_parameter_lanes.safe_polynomial_promotion: fixed constant k; no logarithmic promotion recorded until explicit f(k) is frozen.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Ganian-Ramanujan-Szeider, Backdoor Treewidth for SAT, SAT 2017.

new_parameter_lanes.name: CONSENSUS_TREEWIDTH
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: treewidth k of the consensus graph on clauses (edge iff clauses do not clash)
new_parameter_lanes.runtime: #SAT, hence SAT, in 2^O(k)*L*(L+delta), including a 2^O(k) decomposition approximation route.
new_parameter_lanes.frozen_R50G25X: Explicit clique certificates give consensus-tw lower bounds 20..61; min-fill upper bounds 54..260. This is finite diagnostic only.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Ganian-Szeider, New Width Parameters for Model Counting / SAT and #SAT, SAT 2017 and Artificial Intelligence 2021.

new_parameter_lanes.name: CLUSTERING_WIDTH
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: minimum vertex-cover size of the public obstruction graph; hitting formulas are width 0.
new_parameter_lanes.result: Strong cluster-backdoor detection via vertex cover and #SAT/SAT exact solving; bounded clustering-width gives uniform polynomial time.
new_parameter_lanes.detection_bound: Public paper gives O(1.273^k + n k) for the relevant backdoor/obstruction route.
new_parameter_lanes.polynomial_coverage_condition: k=O(log n) under the explicit single-exponential detection plus 2^O(k) branching/solve route.
new_parameter_lanes.orthogonality: Incomparable with treewidth, branchwidth and clique-width in the cited result.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Nishimura-Ragde-Szeider, Solving #SAT Using Vertex Covers, Acta Informatica 2007.

new_parameter_lanes.name: H_MODULARITY
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: h-modularity k: hitting communities with sparse/tree-like inter-community structure
new_parameter_lanes.discovery: FPT approximation; given k, public algorithm either reports h-mod(F)>k or returns an h-structure of h-modularity <=k^2+k.
new_parameter_lanes.solve: Given h-structure P, SAT in 2^O(h-mod(P)^2)*L^2; #SAT also FPT.
new_parameter_lanes.safe_polynomial_promotion: fixed constant k only in this map; avoid inventing a logarithmic promotion through the k^2 approximation without freezing the entire dependence.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Ganian-Szeider, Community Structure Inspired Algorithms for SAT and #SAT, SAT 2015 / AI 2021.

new_parameter_lanes.name: SIGNED_RANK_WIDTH
new_parameter_lanes.parameter: signed rank-width t of the signed formula graph
new_parameter_lanes.runtime_without_supplied_decomposition: 2^Theta(t^2)*|F|^3 for #SAT/MaxSAT in the cited algorithmic bound; SAT follows from #SAT.
new_parameter_lanes.structural_note: Rank-width can be exponentially smaller than clique-width and is not upper-bounded by treewidth in general.
new_parameter_lanes.reference: Ganian-Hlineny-Obdrzalek, Better Algorithms for Satisfiability Problems for Formulas of Bounded Rank-width, FSTTCS 2010.

representation_or_decomposition_accelera.name: PS_WIDTH
representation_or_decomposition_accelera.result: Weighted MaxSAT and #SAT polynomial when a decomposition of polynomial ps-width is supplied; polynomial decompositions are known for some structured incidence classes.
representation_or_decomposition_accelera.firewall: Do not count arbitrary-CNF ps-width as a discoverable parameter lane unless the decomposition finder is included.
representation_or_decomposition_accelera.reference: Saether-Telle-Vatshelle, Solving MaxSAT and #SAT on structured CNF formulas, 2014.

negative_parameter_guidance.name: CONFLICT_TREEWIDTH
negative_parameter_guidance.reason: SAT is W[1]-hard parameterized by conflict treewidth.
negative_parameter_guidance.reference: Ganian-Szeider, New Width Parameters for SAT and #SAT.

negative_parameter_guidance.name: MODULAR_INCIDENCE_TREEWIDTH
negative_parameter_guidance.reason: #SAT is polynomial for every fixed modular incidence treewidth, but SAT is W[1]-hard parameterized by modular incidence treewidth; polynomial degree depends on k.
negative_parameter_guidance.reference: Paulusma-Slivovsky-Szeider, Model Counting for CNF Formulas of Bounded Modular Treewidth.

frozen_R50G25X_clause_width_profile.significance: Fixed-d public backdoor-to-Forest and backdoor-to-small-treewidth algorithms are applicable to all fifteen residuals.

residual_frontier_v1_2.name: GENERAL_MIXED_RESIDUAL_OUTSIDE_IMPORTED_DIRECT_AND_STRUCTURED_PARAMETER_FUNNEL
residual_frontier_v1_2.warning: The complement is still relative to an incomplete public arsenal. Do not name a new JANUS mechanism until the listed structured-backdoor and orthogonal-width lanes are either imported or responsibly excluded for the target residual.
residual_frontier_v1_2.desired_final_shape: Only after these routes are exhausted should the Universal Residual Funnel theorem attack the remaining intersection with a new exact controlled-growth mechanism.
